name: Openverse
notes: Searchable image index. Verify the original creator page and licence; index metadata is only a lead.

name: Wikimedia Commons
notes: File-level licence and attribution vary. Inspect each source page.

name: Iconify
notes: Many icon families. Select one coherent family and inspect its own licence.

name: The Met Open Access
notes: Built-in search returns objects marked public domain with images. Check the object and image rights.

name: ambientCG
notes: Texture/material library. Inspect https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/ and the actual asset; download a suitable image map, not an executable or archive.

name: Poly Haven
notes: Texture library. Inspect https://polyhaven.com/license and choose a suitable resolution/map for the composition.

name: Hero Patterns
notes: Repeatable SVG patterns. Review the linked CC BY 4.0 terms and retain attribution.

name: unDraw
notes: Editable illustrations. Inspect https://undraw.co/license; use only when the visual language fits the brand.

name: SVG Repo
notes: Licences differ by asset/collection. Inspect https://www.svgrepo.com/page/licensing/ and the exact asset licence.

name: Pexels
notes: Photography. Inspect https://www.pexels.com/license/ and restrictions for people, brands, endorsement and redistribution.

name: Unsplash
notes: Photography; free and paid assets may have different terms. Inspect the exact asset and https://unsplash.com/license.

name: Google Fonts
notes: Check the font family licence, language coverage and embedding terms. Import only the explicitly chosen font files.
